messages:
Priya: Aster is asking to pull their private pilot up by 9 days. Must-have: customer-managed keys (HSM). p95 target = 320ms. Can we quick-triage options?
Omar: Need QPS + model. That drives reserved slot calc and VPC work.
Priya: Peak 80 QPS, avg 20. Model: prefers 13B but okay with 7B if we call it out in SOW.
Sia: Runtime: 7B + continuous batching + KV cache will hit p95 easily. 13B needs pinned nodes or quantization + warm cache. Also suggest routing fallback if HSM not ready.
Noor: Security: HSM onboarding + attestation ~8 business days. We can speed parts but not much. Hosted-KMS fallback is feasible with audit-forwarding in ~3 days.
Alex: Product take: fastest path = hosted-KMS fallback + 7B, but capture customer risk and a signed cutover plan to HSM later.
Sia: Routing sketch (for ops): ```
if request.customer.hsm_required and pool.hsm_ready:
  target = pool-hsm
else:
  target = pool-hosted-kms
canary_guard:
  duration: 10m
  metric: latency.p95
  threshold_ms: 340
  action: rollback
```
Omar: I can provision hosted-kms pool in 72h once model/slots are locked. HSM pool needs infra + security approvals (ETA 8+ biz days).
Noor: If we do hosted-KMS fallback, I'll prepare a customer-facing risk blurb + mitigations (audit logs, restricted key ops).
Priya: Action items: Noor -> HSM checklist + customer blurb (EOD). Omar -> slot calc 13B vs 7B + earliest reserve (tomorrow). Sia -> routing prototype + perf numbers (48h). Alex -> update SOW with fallback & acceptance criteria (today). ops-bot: please create ticket and schedule 30m sync.
ops-bot: Created ticket RDW-8402 "Aster onramp: HSM gating & fallback" and scheduled meeting 1837782000 (3pm PT). Assigned: Priya, Omar, Sia, Noor, Alex.
Priya: Thanks. Default if HSM slips = hosted-KMS + 7B + explicit rollback/cutover runbook. Will send draft SOW to Aster with options and tradeoffs. :thumbsup:
